chartPrimitives.description: Legends, stable colors, formatters, segmented bars and data tables without a chart engine dependency.
chartPrimitives.longName: A long backup category name for checking legend wrapping in narrow containers
chartPrimitives.guidance: Capacity retains actual overflow values and scales drawing to fit. Distribution uses an explicit total for unassigned values. ChartLegend is static unless onSelect performs an explicit consumer action. IDs stabilize category colors; statuses have a separate palette. Percent formatting takes 0.15, not 15. Currency conversion stays in the business layer.
